A description of the Investment Advisory Agreement was included under </span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">"Item 1. Business - Investment Advisory Agreement"</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> of </span><a href="https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2096330/000119312526057161/cvc_pef_form_10_amendmen.htm"><span style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Amendment No. 1 to the Fund's Registration Statement on Form 10</span></a><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">, filed with the Securities Exchange Commission on February 18, 2026 and is incorporated herein by reference. Such summary description of the Investment Advisory Agreement does not purport to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the Investment Advisory Agreement, a copy of which is filed as Exhibit 10.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K and is incorporated herein by reference.</span></h2><h2 style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Item 3.02 Unregistered Sales of Equity Securities.</span></h2><h2 style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">On April 1, 2026, the Fund sold unregistered limited partnership units (the "Units") of the Fund to certain investors, at a price of $100.00 per Unit, as part of its continuous private offering for aggregate consideration of approximately $83.6 million.
